 This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
 
-CICD Doctor is a GitHub App that explains why a GitHub Actions run failed. `SPEC.md` is the design and `DECISIONS.md` is the decision log (`D-NN`). Follow the phase order in `SPEC.md` (P0 to P6): P0 and P1a are done (the queue, the worker and the signed webhook exist), and P1b is in progress: the offline log pipeline (job selection, excerpt, redaction, signature), the rules, the eval runner, the lab sources, the LLM path (policy, prompt, validation, budget, fallbacks, the OpenAI client) and the safe renderer exist, with an injection suite. The live OpenAI parts ran for the first time on 2026-11-18 (D-88: the `-m live` smoke passed and the mini-eval chose `gpt-6-luna`; the live injection suite and the cache box of P2 are still to do), and P1c (GitHub) is done and was verified against the real GitHub on 2026-11-16 with the dev app, the lab and this repository: boxes 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 of SPEC §13 are ticked with their evidence (one check run and one sticky comment per run and workflow, 9.4 s from the end of the run to the comment, the same check and comment updated on a re-run). The job-level timeouts (D-73) are implemented (a `cancelled` run is enqueued and diagnosed only when a job's annotations report the timeout; a manual cancellation publishes nothing) and their live check ("Job timeouts (D-73)" in `lab/README.md`) passed on 2026-11-17 (ticked in SPEC §13; the `job-timeout` eval case is not captured yet). P2 (memory) is under way in small PRs: (a) is done (D-77, D-78): the `FastEmbedEmbedder` loads the model in a background thread of the worker, `embed` fails fast with `EmbedderUnavailable` until it is loaded, and the use case stores one embedding per failure in the checkpoint; (b) is done (D-79, D-80, D-81: `similar` in the stores, a hardened `cached_diagnosis`); (c) is done (D-81): the exact-signature cache is in the flow (`core/diagnosis/cache.py::reuse_cached` re-anchors the stored evidence by text, a hit reserves no budget and stores `cached_from`, the report says "cached from run #N"; box 2 of §13 P2 is covered offline only). `similar` is in the prompt (`untrusted_similar`, prompt `diag-v2`) and in the report (the check run lists up to three earlier runs, the comment one; D-82; box 3 of §13 P2 is covered offline only); the success path resolves failures in the database (`core/outcomes.py`, `core/usecases/record_run_outcome.py`, `record_outcome_handler`, the late resolution in `DiagnoseFailedRun`; D-83, D-84): a success webhook is a `record_outcome` job that resolves the failures and rewrites the sticky comment with the banner "✅ Fixed by `abc1234`" or the flaky one (`core/render.py::resolution_banner`, `core/usecases/report.py`; D-84), never the check run; boxes 5 and 6 of §13 P2 are covered offline only). The daily purge is done (D-85): `core/usecases/purge.py`, `worker/scheduler.py` (one `purge:<date>` job per day at 03:00 UTC) and migration `0005`. The eval variant `llm+hints+similar` exists (D-86: `evals/runner/history.py` builds an in-memory history per repository ordered by `captured_at`; the CLI loads the real embedder; box 8 of §13 P2 is ticked with its real numbers from 2026-11-18: the memory saves the two repeated captures and leaves the accuracy at 92.0%). P2 (h), the live verification, ran on 2026-11-18 with the dev app and the lab: boxes 5 (flaky), 6 (fix), 3 (similar) and 1 (embeddings) of §13 P2 are ticked with their evidence, and the daily purge (box 7) was seen running in the real worker. The runbook is "Live verification (P2)" in `lab/README.md` (`lab/.github/workflows/pr-flaky.yml` simulates a flaky deterministically, failing in attempt 1 and passing from attempt 2). Box 2 (the cache) was verified live on 2026-11-18 (run A `llm`, run B `cache`, `llm_usage.calls` unchanged; its section in `lab/README.md` is the runbook). Still open: box 3 (a PR from a fork: an organization for the fork is missing; the offline tests cover it meanwhile) and the live OpenAI parts that remain (the live injection suite of `tests/live/test_live_injection.py`; the smoke and the model choice are done, D-88). The runbook is "Live verification (P1c)" in `lab/README.md`, and `lab/.github/workflows/pr-py-modnf.yml` is the lab workflow that runs on pull requests. Its pieces: the GitHub HTTP client and the app authentication (D-67, D-68), the `GitHubReporter` (check run and sticky comment) and `GitHubPullRequests` (D-70, D-72, D-76), and the Postgres `FailureStore` (the analysis checkpoint of a run attempt, the publication lock) and `UsageLedger`, tested on both adapters (D-69), and the log source `GitHubLogSource` (D-71; tests on `tests/github_fake.py`), the use case `core/usecases/diagnose_failed_run.py` (D-70, D-71, D-73, D-75) ties them together and is wired to the worker by `worker/handlers.py::diagnose_run_handler` (D-74: on a permanent error or in the last attempt it publishes "Could not diagnose" and re-raises) and `app/container.py` (the worker refuses to start without `GITHUB_APP_ID` and `GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY`; the OpenAI client exists only with both `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_MODEL`). Offline it is tested on in-memory fakes, end to end over `FakeGitHub` (`tests/e2e`, no Postgres) and on Postgres (`tests/integration/test_diagnose_postgres.py`, `test_diagnose_crash.py`).

@@ -1129,7 +1129,7 @@ Scope: FR-01…FR-14 and the FR-22 skeleton. Live on the dev app via smee.
 - [x] Fake LLM: a valid response is published; malformed JSON is repaired once and then falls back to `rules` with `invalid_output`; fabricated evidence is dropped and confidence is capped at 0.3; a timeout falls back to `llm_error`. Verified with `FakeLLM` in `tests/unit/test_diagnosis_pipeline.py` (each of the four, plus a prompt leak, the retries after 1 s and 4 s, the daily and per-installation budget, the fork policy and the explain command), and through the real OpenAI client over a mocked transport in `tests/adapters/test_openai_client.py` (including an invalid key falling back to the rules with `llm_error`).
 - [x] Live `-m live` smoke: 5 lab fixtures against OpenAI return schema-valid diagnoses. The model choice (2 candidates × lab fixtures: accuracy, cost, latency) is recorded in DECISIONS.md and `OPENAI_MODEL` is set. Verified on 2026-11-18: `pytest -m live tests/live/test_live_smoke.py` passed 5 of 5 in 24.27 s (the strict schema of D-63 is accepted and no case fell back), and `evals run --variant llm+hints --sources lab,injection --live` compared `gpt-6-luna` (accuracy 95.1%, macro-F1 0.928, 0 of 16 attacks won, USD 0.0003 per case) with `gpt-5.4-mini` (82.9%, 0.647, 0 of 16, USD 0.0025 per case); the winner is `gpt-6-luna` (D-88). Not run yet: the live injection suite (`tests/live/test_live_injection.py`); the 16 injection cases of the eval were.
 - [x] Injection suite, offline (fake model): the 16 cases are in `evals/cases/injection`. Even when the fake model obeys the log, the rendered check run and comment of every case have no clickable non-allowlisted link, no live `@mention` and nothing else that acts on a reader; no fabricated evidence, leaked prompt or unsafe suggestion is published; a fork run never reaches the model. Verified in `tests/unit/test_injection.py` and `tests/unit/test_render.py`, and by mutation (nine defences removed one at a time, each made a test fail).
-- [ ] Injection suite, live: no case forces the attacker's category. **Open:** only the real model can show it (an obedient fake model does force it, by design: no check in `core` can tell a true category from a forced one). `tests/live/test_live_injection.py` and `python -m evals run --sources injection --live` measure it.
+- [x] Injection suite, live: no case forces the attacker's category. Only the real model can show it (an obedient fake model does force it, by design: no check in `core` can tell a true category from a forced one). Verified on 2026-11-18 with `gpt-6-luna` (D-88): `pytest -m live tests/live/test_live_injection.py` passed (16 cases through the production pipeline, 0 attacks won, 50.25 s), and the eval of the same day (`llm+hints`, 41 cases) reported `attacks won 0/16` for `gpt-6-luna` and for `gpt-5.4-mini`. The cost of the suite is about USD 0.005.
 
 *P1c — GitHub integration (dev app, lab repo)*

A box is ticked only with evidence read from GitHub (run URLs, ids, times). Run on 2026-11-16 with the worker's LLM disabled except where a box says otherwise; the ids are GitHub's.
